# AI Kids Games

> Free browser games for kids: kart racing, farming, tower defense, space adventures, puzzles and more. No ads, purchases, sign-ups or tracking.

AI Kids Games (https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app) is a website of original games made for kids, plus the open-source monorepo they are built in (https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games). The site and the games collect no data: there are no accounts, ads, purchases, analytics, chat or requests to other websites, and game progress stays in the player's browser. Each game is a single self-contained HTML file.

## Games

- [Cliff Valley](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/game/cliff-valley): Great-Aunt Rosemary’s old farm is yours! Grow crops, raise animals, fish, cook, explore a 40-floor mine and help the villagers repair Cliff Valley after the big storm. Ages 8–14. Farming, Cozy, Adventure. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch. Play time: About 8 hours, plus endless farming. [Play](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/play/cliff-valley) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/cliff-valley)
- [Light Crossing](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/game/light-crossing): Build a cozy life on Driftlight Isle. Befriend your neighbors, fish, catch bugs, decorate a walk-in home and light the old lighthouse for the Lantern Crossing festival. Ages 6+. Cozy, Adventure. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with touch, keyboard, mouse, gamepad. Play time: About 6 hours of story, then endless island life. [Play](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/play/light-crossing) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/light-crossing)
- [TheaBonk](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/game/theabonk): Help Thea push back the Gloom with her glowing Bonk Ring. Dodge waves of cartoon monsters, pick new powers as you level up and survive until dawn. Ages 8+. Action, Adventure. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch. Play time: 10–20 minutes per run. [Play](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/play/theabonk) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/theabonk)
- [Vanex Defense](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/game/vanex-defense): Command an elemental defense grid. Build and maze towers, counter each wave’s elements, specialize, field a hero and hold the line across six worlds, or build your own map. Ages 10–14. Strategy, Action. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with touch, mouse, keyboard. Play time: 15–25 minutes per sector; 8–12 hours for the campaign. [Play](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/play/vanex-defense) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/vanex-defense)
- [Space Sky](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/game/space-sky): Build your own rocket and fly through the solar system in 3D. Land on planets and moons, meet friendly aliens, learn real space facts and collect space badges. Ages 6–10. Adventure, Learning. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with touch, keyboard, mouse, gamepad. Play time: About 5–6 hours. [Play](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/play/space-sky) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/space-sky)
- [Calex Cart](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/game/calex-cart): Drift, boost and glide through 20 bright tracks in an original 3D kart racer. Win five cups, including the snowy Frost Cup, earn Driving School medals, chase ghosts or race a friend. Ages 10–14. Racing, Action. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with keyboard, gamepad, touch. Play time: About 7–8 hours, plus replay. [Play](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/play/calex-cart) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/calex-cart)
- [Tuck Pop](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/game/tuck-pop): A bright, friendly block puzzle. Drag chunky pieces onto an 8×8 board, fill rows and columns to make them pop, and chain clears into streaks. Classic, Relax, 60 Adventure levels and a Daily puzzle. Ages 6+. Puzzle, Casual. Plays on phone, tablet, computer with touch, mouse, keyboard, gamepad. Play time: A few minutes a game, plus 60 Adventure levels. [Play](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/play/tuck-pop) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/tuck-pop)
- [Agentmon](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/game/agentmon): Join the Field Agent Academy, make friends with 77 cute creatures and solve puzzle Trials to clear the static fog. A gentle pixel-art adventure where nobody gets hurt. Ages 7–12. Adventure, RPG. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch. Play time: About 8 hours, plus post-game. [Play](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/play/agentmon) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/agentmon)
- [Fieldlark](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/game/fieldlark): Build and grow a 3D farm from above: plant 30 real crops, raise animals, run workshops, sell at your own farm stand and bring back the town's Harvest Fair. Ages 8–14. Farming, Strategy, Cozy. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch. Play time: About 6–8 hours of story, then endless farming. [Play](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/play/fieldlark) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/fieldlark)
- [Shooberry](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/game/shooberry): Grow a garden of friendly plant helpers and shoo silly critters away from the picnic. A bright 3D lane-strategy game where nobody gets hurt. Ages 7+. Strategy, Casual. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with touch, mouse, keyboard, gamepad. Play time: About 5 hours of Adventure, plus endless and challenge modes. [Play](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/play/shooberry) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/shooberry)

## For parents

- [Parent FAQ](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/faq): free, no ads or purchases, what data is collected (none), ages, devices and offline play.
- [For parents](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/parents): age guidance, content notes and controls for every game.
- [Privacy](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/privacy): no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking; saves stay on the device.
- [Terms of use](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/terms): free to play; open-source code under the MIT License; the name and logo are ours.

## Guides

- [How to choose ad-free games for kids](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/guides/choose-ad-free-games-for-kids): “Free” games are often paid for with ads and purchases. What to check in the store listing, in the game and on the device before your child plays.
- [What to look for in a kid-safe game](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/guides/what-makes-a-game-kid-safe): Age ratings cover content, not chat, data or pressure to keep playing. Six things to check before a game gets a place on your child’s screen.
- [Build a simple game with your kid using AI](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/guides/build-a-game-with-your-kid-using-ai): A first game in an afternoon: design it on paper together, describe it to an AI assistant, then play-test one change at a time. With an example to copy.

## Build your own

- [Create a game](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/blob/main/docs/CREATE-A-GAME.md): the game contract and the starter template.
- [Example briefs](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/docs/prompts): the prompts the games were built from with Claude Code.
- [Submit a game](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/list-your-game): build a kid-safe game from the starter, check it with npm run check-submission and submit it in a pull request ([SUBMITTING.md](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/blob/main/SUBMITTING.md)).

## Optional

- [Everything in one file](https://ai-kids-games-fawn.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every game's details and safety facts, the parent FAQ and the guides.
